description: This file defines an enumeration MatchMode with methods for pattern matching styles used in database querying, such as starting with, ending with, or containing a substring, along with methods for generating case-sensitive and case-insensitive patterns.

classes.name: MatchMode
classes.description: An enumeration representing different patterns for matching strings in database queries, providing methods to generate patterns with different case sensitivities.

methods.name: toCaseSensitivePattern
methods.description: Creates a case-sensitive pattern string based on the specified input.

methods.name: toLowerCasePattern
methods.description: Creates a case-insensitive (lowercase) pattern string based on the specified input.

methods.name: toPatternInternal
methods.description: Internal method to generate pattern strings based on the matching mode and case sensitivity flag.
